text:
Marta (Finance): Aquarius Labs invoice AQ-9921 for $9,320 came in but Coupa matched it to PO 9921 (Helios) instead of vendor Aquarius. Vendor says PO 9921-2025 exists. Need owner + fix before due date in 6 days.
Amit (ProcureOps): Upload the invoice and vendor portal screenshot. Likely a vendor ID collision in our supplier registry.
invoicer-bot: Invoice AQ-9921 uploaded via vendor portal (auto-match confidence: 2%).
Tara (Vendor): Hi team, we sent PO ref 9921-2025 and SOW last week. Our AR team is asking about remittance; they'd like payment by 04/07 to avoid a finance hold.
Marta (Finance): Attached invoice PDF and SOW. Bank last4 9876. Coupa shows supplier ID 4501 linked to Helios; Aquarius should be 4572.
Amit (ProcureOps): Got it. We'll need to unmap supplier 4501 from new invoices and map 4572 to PO 9921-2025. But we need to confirm the SOW execution and GL coding.
Priya (Ops): This was requested by my team for a short-term infra trial. PR-2025-TRIAL exists and was approved by @Ken. Contract signed by vendor rep but CLA in CLM shows missing countersignature.
Luis (Legal): If CLM shows missing countersign, we require either countersign or an email acceptance of our standard terms before creating a retro PO. Can the vendor confirm in writing?
Tara (Vendor): I can confirm in email that they accept Redwood standard T&Cs and delivered the services. Sending confirmation to this thread now.
Marta (Finance): GL code should be 5300-INFRA-TRIAL. Vendor email received.
Amit (ProcureOps): Plan: create retro PO 9921-2025-retro mapped to supplier 4572, route to Priya for ops approval and to Luis for legal ACK (commercial only). Update Coupa supplier mapping to prevent future mis-match.
Ken (Payments): We can do a limited prepayment hold for 50% while mapping and legal ack are in progress, if Ops requests and Treasury approves. That will prevent service interruption.
Priya (Ops): Please hold only 30% — vendor already delivered partial services. I'll approve retro PO once Coupa mapping updated and legal gives ACK.
Luis (Legal): I can issue a commercial ACK email within 2 hours once I see vendor acceptance. Will not be a full countersign but sufficient for procurement retro PO.
Amit (ProcureOps): Creating retro PO 9921-2025-retro now. Note field: "Retro PO for AQ-9921; mapping collision with Helios 4501. Do not auto-close." Tagging Priya and Luis.
Marta (Finance): Vendor wants fast turnaround to avoid late fee. Can Payments do an expedited sweep if approval completes today?
Ken (Payments): If PO matched and legal ACK in by 5pm PT, we can include in tonight's expedited sweep. Otherwise next cycle.
Tara (Vendor): Appreciate the quick help. I'll confirm acceptance of T&Cs via the email thread.
Marta (Finance): Thanks all — please confirm when Coupa mapping is fixed so I can mark invoice matched and queue payment. :pray:
